body:
The zip file you uploaded is not minimal. It contains what looks to be a full game prototype.

Ran it anyway and it froze on assignment. 4.4beta4 on windows 10.

Are you able to workaround it and use a NodePath as the key instead?

> The zip file you uploaded is not minimal. It contains what looks to be a full game prototype.

Sorry, I will try to upload a new cleaner file. I uploaded this one as when I made a new project, the issue didn't show up.

> Are you able to workaround it and use a NodePath as the key instead?

Just tried this, hit CTRL + S and the editor froze. Opened it again and commented the line, had a bunch of issues with dependencies, reloaded the project, changed to NodePath and it seems to be working fine. This is more prone to error though, as the type is not fixed and usability with a huge list can suffer too. But it works, thank you. This ends up being better than using resource which don't support nodes in export vars.

[dict-bugreport-250220-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18892864/dict-bugreport-250220-2.zip)

Here's a cleaner project for testing with the sames steps described above, commented out some code too to check that it was not the issue. Still trying to reproduce it on a clean project to no success, either with direct classes or inherited.

I've found another workaround while doing this, which requires reloading the project multiple times:
- Comment the dictionary on line 10 of state.gd
- Reload project
- Remove comment from line
- Reload project

It works again, but all previous settings are lost.

Managed to recreate it on a new project, sorry for multiple comments, let me know if it is best to update the original.

[dict-bugreport-20250220-3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18893181/dict-bugreport-20250220-3.zip)

- Select NodeA
- Click "Assign" in transitions dictionary
- Select any Entity

Further testing it, I noticed that if using "Entity" dictionary, crash only occurs upon adding a second key.

- "Assign" NodeA -> OK
- "Assign" NodeB -> Crash

Happens on any order. Nodes A to C are inherited, whereas Entity 1 to 4 are the base script. Assigning any of them doesn't crash, it only happens when using inheritance.

I'm seeing the call stack below when it freezes, looks like it's trying to set a tooltip based on the assigned object, and calls `VariantWriter::write` recursively - possibly a cycle between two or more nodes including transitions to each other, not sure why the inherited type affects it though.  May be related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96418, but based on objects in dictionaries instead of properties.

> not sure why the inherited type affects it though. May be related to [#96418](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96418), but based on objects in dictionaries instead of properties.

This is because `Variant::get_construct_string()` is called by `EditorPropertyDictionaryObject` to generate the name of the key for display in inspector.

It is essentially a duplicate of #96418.

Adding some extra notes here in case they help with triage/solve:
- Still happening on 4.5.rc1, have not tried in 4.6.* yet
- Does not seem to be a problem for Resources - a Resource with a Dictionary whose Key and Value types are also Resources works fine. 
  - Workflow can be a little jank - e.g. an inline Resource saved as a key can't subsequently be saved out to file - you can't right-click > Make Unique and then save to disk - but this is a very minor complaint vs what this issue is about!
- Suspect this is just a problem for Nodes

I haven't time to look into it further at the moment, but tag me if you need any more digging done and I can try to make time

> 4.5.rc1

Assuming you mean 4.5.2.rc1? I'm assuming you don't mean a two version old pre-release from 6 months ago

I did indeed mean the old one (v4.5.rc1.official [08e9e6b29])! Currently sitting on that for this project for various reasons, will likely be shuffling to a newer version Soon ™️

That said, I just downloaded and checked a couple other versions and found the same bug symptoms present
- 4.5.2-rc1
- 4.6.1-rc1

While testing I did notice the classes (extending Control) had one obvious cyclic reference to each other, which wasn't needed. However, removing that didn't fix the issue, still had the freeze occur. I suspect I should also try make time next week to test some other more minimal circumstances in case there's a workaround that lets us use a typed dict for this in the inspector
I somehow got this bug in godot 4.7. Has a solution been found yet?
